ASDF Graphics, “Acid Font – Acid Graphics Typography”

A commercial display typeface sold under the name “acid graphics typography”, shown in acid yellow-green on black with spiky, wide, sharp-cut letters.

MasterBundles: ACID FONT – ACID GRAPHICS TYPOGRAPHY
Creator

Rights
Link and metadata only. License: unverified. Rights policy

Context

MasterBundles lists the product under Fonts › Blackletter, as “ACID FONT – ACID GRAPHICS TYPOGRAPHY”, created by ASDF Graphics, with OTF files. MasterBundles.

The same title appears on Creative Market and Creative Fabrica, which shows that “acid graphics” works as a market label for this kind of face.

Observed

  • The ground is near-black with a grainy noise texture.
  • All type and ornament are in one acid yellow-green.
  • The word “ACID” is set large in the center in wide letters with sharp, angled cuts and spurs. Two outline copies sit above and below it.
  • “A DISPLAY TYPEFACE” runs around an arch on a curved baseline.
  • Long, thin four-point stars, circular rose ornaments, chains of rings, and checkered bars fill the corners and margins.
  • Small blocks of justified capitals sit in the upper corners.
  • A photograph of a Baroque ceiling fresco fills the arch behind the type.

Why it belongs

The specimen is a stock version of the style: one acid green on black, spiky letters, ornaments, and dense micro text. It does not use chrome. The name on the product is evidence that the label is in commercial use.

Borrow

Set a secondary line on a curved path around the main image.

Fill the margins with small spiky stars and ring chains in the accent color.
